kind: gen_input (pristine 10 x 10 x 10 core-shell cell + the poling deck + the field-loop deck; descriptor rubric + REQUIRED deck rules)
provenance: Structure: our as-run 3_reproduction/L1/auditor/input.lmp (build_bto_coreshell.py, a0 = 3.96786 A, 10000 particles). Decks: our as-run 3_reproduction/L1/auditor/decks/pole.in and loop_aniso.in (the authors' deposited relaxation.in / hysteresis.in potential block, asserted verbatim by make_decks.py; alternating cg box / fire ion minimiser), file names adapted to the prompt. Field list: the authors' deposited field.txt (55 values), restated as agent/field_steps.csv in MV/cm.

structure.rules: Exact species/role and bond counts; net charge magnitude <0.001 e; each particle in exactly one seed-compatible core-shell bond, paired molecule IDs; core-shell distance <=0.2 A. All ionic core sites match distinct retained seed sites within 0.05 A in the fixed seed frame, allowing order, consistent IDs and periodic coordinate wrapping. No arbitrary global translation or strip shift. Existing box bands retained; L3 x precompression can be encoded in data.
structure.core_site_tolerance_basis: Reuse the earlier 0.05 A L1 spatial registry allowance for complete seed-site matching; no tighter serialization or floating-point endpoint gate.

model.class2_mapping: bond_coeff <type> 0.0 K2 K3 K4 with K2 = k2/2, K3 = 0, K4 = k4/24

required_both_runs: effective charges per core/shell type = the model's (1e-3)
buck/coul/long/cs or supported buck/coul/long, cutoff >=12 A; coincident core-shell submitted initial data require appropriate zero-distance handling
All type-pair coefficients defined; specified shell-shell Buckingham coefficients within existing 0.5 percent tolerance, A=C=0 elsewhere; undefined does not equal zero
kspace_style pppm | pppm/cg | ewald with accuracy <= 1e-5
bond_style class2, r0 = 0, K2 = k2/2, K3 = 0, K4 = k4/24 per species (1 percent)
effective same-ion 1-2 Coulomb weight zero, including correct defaults

Three independent cell lengths at zero target stress, fixed angles; aniso or equivalent x/y/z; active over joint minimization, alternating with position-only minimization and repeated without a prescribed count
every minimize: etol = 0, finite 0 < ftol <= 1e-3 eV/A; actual convergence is not evaluated
required_pole: fix efield 0 0 0.1 (10 MV/cm along +z, 5 percent) with fix_modify <id> energy yes
required_loop: read_data poled.lmp, continued state without an initial-cell reset
ordered effective field/relaxation/write events matching all 55 CSV values within 0.1 percent (floor 1e-6 V/A)
effective field energy contribution during minimizations
one state_<CSV-step-label>.lmp output per field; ordinary loops and explicit unrolled forms accepted
not_graded: min_style, timestep, min_modify, box/relax options (vmax, nreset), the number of passes per step, thermo, neighbor settings, comm_modify, processors
whether the field values are inline or read from a file
deck.coverage_note: Seed coordinates remain the target; 0.2 A shell tolerance is grading slack, not initialization permission. Repeat alternating relaxation but do not grade a particular count or actual convergence. Optional output/runtime state is not inferred.
deck.parser_scope: Bounded constants, ordinary loop/file/index forms, static groups and relevant active fixes. Supported runtime relaxation conditionals use two representative bodies to verify repetition, never actual convergence. Unsupported relevant control flow is diagnosed.
deck.coefficient_handoff: Future poled.lmp is not required in the submission. Only its preceding write_data coefficient policy can establish supplied coefficients: nocoeff none, default diagonal, pair ij all pairs; do not reuse initial geometry-proxy coefficients.

score: 1 only if the structure rubric and every REQUIRED rule of both runs pass
reference_verification: Static reference and complete-submission tests only. Finite reference cycles are not proof of convergence or exact reproduction of the canonical relaxed endpoints; L3 relaxation remains not reproduced.
parser_semantics: Same-file jumps accept SELF, current script names, ./ aliases and resolved variable names. String-variable redefinition uses the latest value. The bounded trace checks active physical protocol; it is not a general LAMMPS interpreter or convergence certification.
